### The Lord Who Heals You
Author: Melissa Spoelstra
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-july-20-2021.html
Passage: Exodus 15:26
Points:
- God revealed Himself as Yahweh Rapha when He purified the undrinkable water at Marah.
- Divine goodness is constant and should not be judged merely by whether physical healing comes in our preferred timing.
- Human brokenness extends beyond bodily illness into emotional, relational, and spiritual afflictions.
- Jesus offers the living water that cleanses our sinful nature and brings ultimate, eternal restoration.
- Wilderness seasons test our faith and invite deeper trust in God as our healer through all outcomes.

### The Bitter Made Sweet
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-bitter-made-sweet
Passage: Exodus 15:22-27
Points:
- Hard trials often follow shortly after seasons of spiritual victory and deliverance.
- Legitimate human needs and anxieties should prompt believers to pray rather than grumble.
- The piece of wood purifying the bitter water points forward to the cross making afflictions bearable.
- God uses life's wilderness tests to teach His people faithful obedience and submission.
